versions.changelog:
Initial release v1.0.0:
- OKX DEX Aggregator Quote API v6 integration
- HMAC-SHA256 authenticated requests
- Support for exactIn/exactOut swap modes
- Multi-chain support (Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, Solana, etc.)
- Production-ready Python client with CLI support
- Honeypot detection and price impact warnings
- Token decimal auto-conversion (human-readable <-> raw amounts)
